A steward came over and declared that he was now the academy master of the school in front of him before disappearing to nothingness.
“That damn steward said I am now the owner of this place then left me all alone! What the hell am I supposed to teach them anyway?!”
He feared that some prodigious arrogant young master would come over and enroll when he himself didn’t know what he was supposed to do.
“But this is a deserted academy, right? No one should come over here, right?”
Unfortunately, his nightmare came about.
“Academy Master, I am here to enroll in the Heavenly Magic Academy. Please allow my request in behalf of my lackluster talent.”
Eluard Kai almost blacked out until he heard a prompt in his head.
[ A student requests to enter the Heavenly Magic Academy. ]
[ Accept the request? ]
myriad-dragon-divine-sovereign: Ahead lie mountains of bones and a sea of blood; he comes from Longevity, with no path to take, only a path of nine deaths and one life.
myths-reawakened:
A software engineer in his original world, Wayne enters the Chosen Land as a third-rate detective, running an agency on the verge of bankruptcy with nothing but potatoes filling his stomach. Just as he’s getting tired of potatoes, though, fate comes knocking in the form of a pretty girl, a burly man, and a cat. He’s led into a brand new world within this world, which is already foreign to him. Thus begins his adventure of intrigues and mysteries, with a healthy dose of misunderstandings and other shenanigans.
Official Blurb:
Morning. The light of dawn arrived late, and the lingering radiance of the sun had already faded into darkness. In the city covered in a thin layer of mist, in the church hidden in shadows, in the veins crawling along the walls, amid the noises of gnawing and the whispering silhouettes… a lone figure walked with a lantern.
naruto-world-tenseigan:
After treading carefully for so long, Hyuga Kagami finally obtained the treasure of his dreams...
Through the sapphire-blue Tenseigan, what kind of world of Naruto will reveal before his eyes?
omega-ascension-systembl:

Elian Ashford was a lowly Omega and an orphan raised as a palace slave in the werewolf empire of Lunaria. He was hated, humiliated, and eventually poisoned to death after finding out that he was mated to the cold Alpha Prince of Lunaria who had publicly rejected him.
But fate wasn't done with him.
The moon goddess showed pity on him and gave him a second chance at life, making him start all over again from the point when the Alpha Prince's rejection came.
But Elian soon discovered how vastly different his second life was.…
reaper-of-the-drifting-moon:
He’s in the deepest part of Jianghu.
Keep your eyes wide open.
If you do not wish to get dragged into the abyss.
rebirth-of-the-bastard-spirit-summoner:
He was the discarded bastard. The lord his people betrayed. Now he will take his destiny in his hands and rewrite his fate.
In the Continent of Zethon, there exist three schools of power.
—Archaios> the Tamers, the oldest and purest form of power. It is said to be as old as the first men.
—Magia> the Mages, individuals capable of forming a core and manifesting their mana in the form of spells.
And the darkest of all…
—Motus Animí> Awakeners, people who wielded divine relics born out of emotions, wielders of the void and catalysts for doom.
Stark watched his family die before his eyes, too weak to do anything to stop it, or even prevent his own death.
Seething with a rage so maddening that it called even the attention of the gods, he was granted one of these Relics, becoming one of the awakened.
With each kill potentially expanding his army of Spirits, and each spirit absorption magnifying his strength, Stark finally gets a taste of power for the very first time.
And armed with a power that could rival a nation, he sets his eyes on those who wronged him.…
reincarnated-and-regressed-villain-make-:
“So, Diana, what's your excuse for betraying me?”
His amber glinted eyes bore into the woman with bloodied, broken blue hair, kneeling in complete disarray.
“... you're evil.”
“Oh, so, looking out for all of you makes me evil?”
The man narrowed his eyes, contemplating the echoes of protagonist halos and heroines' mentality, starkly real now.
Coming from a world far removed from such grim reality, he had read about these personalities in novels, but experiencing their shortcomings firsthand was a different story.
“How am I evil?”
He looked down at his foot where a young man, limbless and crushed, lay in a state of complete brokenness, mustering the little strength he had left to utter some words.
“... y.. you ba..stard, You killed millions.”
Hearing these words, the man's internal amusement grew at the absurdity of these hypocritical people.
He had eradicated all the evil organizations within the Empire after ascending to his throne.
Wars were waged to crush rebellious kingdoms that stood against his Empire, uniting the entire Heidal Continent under one flag—the Selvius Empire.…
release-that-succubus:
Zach was a sci-fi game enthusiast who unintentionally crossed over to a magical isekai. Fortunately, he had access to the previous game system and could fight the magic-savvy aborigines with high-tech weapons.
“Magic? No, I have the lightsaber. ”
Unlike what he expected, the system presented him with a different way of leveling up. He had to get some kind of special energy from the pretty girls' bodies on this planet so that he could unlock his weapons.
“What the hell happened? Is my sperm capable of upgrading girls? Can my blood cause those girls to burst out instantly?”
This was incredible.
The succubi were a hated race in the magical isekai because they oversucked male sperm and killed men, but not Zach.
Surprisingly, the majority of the special energy that Zach required was distributed in succubi.
He appeared to be having a fantastic journey.
renegades-battlegrounds:
When fifteen-year-old Ren Ryūhara's brother falls into a coma after a brutal knife attack, Ren transfers into Sakura High as a first year student to uncover the truth.
There, he discovers that his older brother founded the school's most notorious gang!. Ren is this levethrust into a world of territory wars, honor codes, and brutal street fights.
The charismatic but enigmatic Fujimoto Hasegawa now leads Sakuratei, and he reveals that Crimson Dragons are responsible for Kaito's condition. War is brewing, and Ren must choose either he walks away from his brother's legacy, or dives into the violence that destroyed Kaito's life.
But Ren is hiding a terrifying secret. He is experiencing visions.. terrible visions, flashes of violence, blood, and a future that hasn't happened yet. With his new deadly ability to leap through time he could save or destroy everything.
What would you sacrifice to save someone you love? And what if saving them meant losing yourself?
strength-based-wizard:
Joseph Sullivan is at an all-time low. He lost his job, his fiancée dumped him, he moved back to the Midwest and currently lives in his parent’s basement—oh, and his workout was just interrupted with the arrival of the System.
Earth has become a playing field in a contest amongst the gods, where mortals are the pawns. The winning god gets the glory, and their chosen champion gets a single wish. The first stage of this game: Tutorial – Class Selection.
Provided the ideal stat array for a physical, combat-focused class, the choice for Joe is obvious. Until he fat thumbs the selection screen and ends up selecting Spellcaster. His starting Intelligence stat? 1.
With a useless class selection and only his raw testosterone-fueled strength to back him up, Joe decides class optimization is for dummies. Pumping all stat points in Strength, he hopes to not only survive the contest of the gods, but to win the whole damned thing.
After all, a real wizard should be measured by how much they can bench!
strongest-hive-lord-endlessly-evolving-m:
“What do you mean I'm the father!?”
In a world shattered by a devastating meteor shower, nature has turned hostile.
The skies bled strange lights, wild life mutated into horrors, and humanity awakened to supernatural powers in a desperate bid for survival. Cities became fortresses, and the awakened, powerful humans were the military might of every nation.
But not everyone was gifted.
Riven, an F-ranked Awakened, is a Cleaner — the lowest rung on the ladder. His job? Scrape up monster guts, salvage what’s valuable, and stay out of the way. His life is simple, thankless, and dangerous in the shadows of real heroes.
That is, until the day he cuts open the corpse of a grotesque chitinous behemoth… and finds a strange cocoon pulsing with life.
One thing led to another it later hatched.
And she stepped out.
supreme-daily-login-system:
: Victor was just an ordinary college student, ready to lose his virginity to his girlfriend, when a mysterious white light struck him down. He wakes up in the body of a young cultivator from a destroyed clan, his meridians crippled, his family slaughtered, and his body inhabited by a soul from another world.
But fate isn't done with him yet.
A voice echoes in his mind: [Supreme Daily Login System activated].
Now Victor possesses the most coveted power in the Spiritualis World—a system that grants divine rewards for simply signing in every day. With each login, he gains cosmic-level cultivation techniques, legendary physiques, and enough wealth to buy kingdoms.
Yet power isn't the only thing calling to him.
Surrounded by five breathtaking women—his devoted mother Anna, his teasing aunt Clara, his cold sister-in-law Rias, and his two loyal maids Skyla and Lane—Victor finds himself in a world where desire and cultivation intertwine. And as he discovers the forbidden Genesis Dual Cultivation Scripture, he realizes that strengthening his body might be just as pleasurable as strengthening his cultivation.
But shadows loom.
The enemies who destroyed his clan are still out there.…
surviving-zombies-was-easier-than-raisin:
Swanly survived the zombie apocalypse, died anyway, and woke up in a beast world where infected creatures still roam the forests.
Worse, she opened her eyes in the body of a hated snow fox beastwoman who once ate poison to escape her black panther mate and their three tiny cubs.
Now the cubs call her Mama, her possessive panther mate refuses to let her go, her guilty system has dragged her into another infected world, and Swanly has no choice but to survive all over again.
But this time, survival comes with beastmen.
And the black panther may only be the first beastman whose fate gets tangled with hers. In this world, powerful males do not let go easily, ancient bloodlines still hide in the wild, and Swanly’s quiet plan to survive alone is about to be laughed at by the heavens.
Swanly only wanted to stay alive.
Unfortunately, this world wants her mated, protected, pregnant, worshipped, chased by monsters, and buried under a growing pile of fluffy, clingy beast babies who keep calling her Mama.
And somehow, surviving zombies was easier.
synthetic-wizard:
Transmigrated with a player panel and a Synthesis Cube into the game world he played in his previous life, Sunan became a noble whose title was taken away.
At this time, the continent is still an Elemental Desert, and the powerful Wizards abandoned this world a thousand years ago to explore the multiverse. Wizards gradually became an elusive legend.
Only Sunan knows that a thousand years later, with the revival of elements and the return of Wizards, the continent is about to usher in a prosperous Wizard era.
What he needs to do is simple.
Work hard to cultivate and become a Wizard, and live until the arrival of the Wizard era!
“Lack of resources?”
“No problem, I'll just synthesize them myself.”
Sunan opened the Synthesis Cube.
the-healer-more-powerful-than-a-warrior:
In his previous life, Lin Ye was tricked by his crush losing the hidden War God profession. Reborn in this life, the first thing he decides is to never be persuaded again to become the unfortunate Healer...
However, he finds his talent has changed into Healing Dominator.
The next second, Lin Ye is over the moon when he sees his Attributes.
Attribute 1: When your healing takes effect, there's a chance to gain permanent attribute point bonuses and a very low probability of acquiring the opponent's talent.
Attribute 2: When your healing takes effect, there's a chance to acquire special items 'Spiritual Essence' (can be used to refine equipment attributes).
Attribute 3: Any Healing Technique you use only consumes one point of Mana Value, and requires no casting materials.
Attribute 4: Each time healing is accumulated, it can be used to enhance talent or skill ratings (current accumulated healing volume: 0).
the-king-of-urban-mercenaries:
Once the young leader of Dragon Soul, acknowledged king among international top mercenaries, he is pulled back to the city by his thrifty father-in-law to find himself a cold goddess.
Being disliked by the goddess is not a problem; a spicy policewoman, charming boss, tsundere lolita, and sweet college student come knocking at his door.
More women means more trouble, but that's not a problem either. What he's least lacking is the skill to solve problems!
Lin Fei's life motto: What is love in this world? Only wishing life and death for it!
the-maknae-has-to-be-an-idol:
“I will leave the debut group.”
I can’t make it in this group. I should leave and set up a chicken restaurant so that my brothers could at least make a name for themselves.
Destined to be a failed idol, I decided to leave the group for the betterment of the others.
However,
[A member dies if you leave the debut group.]
What?
“…This is making me crazy.”
The struggles of Bong Tae-Yoon, the Maknae on top, whose hands hold the lives of his group members, begins now!
the-novels-sidekick:
Just because you can’t explain it, doesn’t make it a miracle. Something like that happened to Aaron, an introverted youth, who expected to live a normal, boring life. But it took a little for the expectation to go wrong. Who knew he would transmigrate into his favourite Web novel, Forbidden Realms?
Waking up in the mysterious land, Aaron finds himself reincarnated as Scar, the loyal sidekick. But soon he found out it was not the only change.
Magic still exists in Forbidden realms, with the blessing of the twelve heroes who had stood against the end of time in the sky breaking, catastrophic war fifteen hundred years ago.
Unfortunately, the end of time comes once again. The bleeding moons in the broken sky, the wind of the end that sweeps across the rocky terrain to the snow-filled land, all cry the foretell of desolation.
Bearing the responsibility and knowledge imparted to him through the book, Scar unravels the mysteries shrouded in the pages of history and myth, while slowly developing his newfound powers along with others to stand against the end of time.…
the-return-of-godkin:
Raymond, aka Ray, is a young boy born with a weak martial soul, Silverfalls Vine, and low soul power. Because of this, he is treated as talentless. However, he refuses to give up. With hard work, forging skills, and the guidance of his teacher Alfred, Ray slowly proves that he is not ordinary.
During a critical period, Ray discovers a sealed power inside his body, the Golden Dragon King, which is considered a kin of the Gods. With great pain and risk, he breaks the first seal and gains terrifying physical strength, dragon might, and the Golden Dragon Claw. Although his soul power is still low, his body becomes far stronger than that of ordinary Soul Masters.
Together with his teammates, Raziel Phoenix, a dual-martial-soul genius, and Lily, a mysterious girl who can control multiple elements, Ray leads Class Five to defeat several stronger classes in the Class Promotion Tournament. In a fierce battle against class two, Ray’s hidden power erupts, shocking the entire academy.
Because of their outstanding talent, Ray and his teammates are selected into a newly created elite group, Class Zero, directly guided by Alfred.…
the-royals-cute-little-wife:
In childhood, they were neighbors. Xie Zhen always bullied Li Yu.
Who told him to be as beautiful as a girl?
After parting for many years, they met again in the capital. With a tall stature and heroic bearing, he seemed like a completely different person.
Not only that, but his identity had also risen to that of the sixth prince.
Hearing he wanted to marry her, Xie Zhen was almost scared silly:
Σ(っ °Д °;)っ What’s his intention? Taking revenge on her?
the-sinner-hunting-system:
Tonight, Raphael enters the hunt.
The System never forgives failure. Kill, or be killed.
Every hunt makes him stronger. Every hunt makes him less human.
On the first day, he hunts Demons, drawing their power through contracts and making it his own.
On the second day, he hunts Witches, forging bonds to synchronize their minds and wield their magic.
On the third day, he hunts sinners, claiming bounties paid in blood, even if it means bearing their sins.
Now, this city is Raphael’s hunting ground.
Blood stains his hands.
Sin corrodes his soul.
To hunt monsters,
he will become one first.
the-untamed-game-of-hearts:
[r18+ content / Book Status: COMPLETED]
She described herself as his worst nightmare. But to him, she was his most beautiful dream...
A vicious and dangerous vixen… A ticking bomb that no one could diffuse… This was how Raine, the infamous Princess of one of the three clans of an underworld group called MIRAGE, was often described by humans and the mythical creatures in disguise coexisting with humans.
Everyone was scared of her. Well... everyone except for one man who never batted an eye meeting her glare.
Could he be the only one who could tame the untamed? Or would he end up getting played by the naughty and dangerous Princess of the Moon Clan?

“You should have known that I’m willing to play any game you want just to stay by your side. After all… you’re my sweet vixen…” He leaned closer to the point where his lips almost touched hers, “You're not someone that can be easily forgotten.…
toaru-majutsu-no-index-ss-kanzaki:
A series of short stories in the world of Toaru Majutsu no Index organized into chapters featuring Kanzaki Kaori as the protagonist, going around the world and space doing missions for the Church of Necessary Evil, however, there is more than meets the eye as each incident is connected.
One chapter was bundled with each limited edition release of the Toaru Kagaku no Railgun anime DVD and BDs, with all of them together being equivalent to a single normal Toaru Majutsu no Index volume
transmigration-from-farmer-to-empress:
Once upon a time-travel leap, Mu Caiwei, the gold-medal bodyguard, turned into a poor peasant girl, Mu Caiwei, who starved to death.
With nothing to their name, and an empty rice vat, facing a skinny, malnourished mother and a bunch of hungry younger siblings, Mu Caiwei rolled up her sleeves and shouted, “Sister's going to get rich!”
Although she had followed a proud and aloof path in her past life, times were now different.…
trickster-god-in-another-world:
Perry, the greatest gamer on earth, is suddenly selected by a system to travel to another dimension.
He is reborn in a world where humans have begun making contracts with gods to gain their powers and fight the Voidborns.
But Perry is not reborn as any other person … He is reborn as the God of Tickery.
Follow Perry, now turned Lukas, as he creates his pantheon from scratch.
Even if it means deceiving the entire world
unholy-player:
(Warning: This novel has an r18 tag and contains mature content.)
Adyr, once a notorious serial killer, met a brutal end and welcomed death as the final judgment for his sins.
But he awoke in a parallel Earth, where the rich alter their genes and superhumans are the norm.
Believing some unknown force had given him a second chance, Adyr buried the monster within and chose a quiet, normal life.
For eighteen years, he lived in poverty with his family, suppressing his urges and forcing himself to be human.
Until the day he entered a new VRMMORPG.
A game that doesn’t just alter virtual stats but mutates real genes and pushes players toward evolution.
And with every evolution, his bloodlust surfaced again, turning him back into the villain he once was.
urban-god-of-war-the-live-in-son-in-law:
He once stained the rivers and mountains with blood, his brilliance unparalleled.
Unexpectedly, he encountered a great calamity, a dragon trapped in shallow waters, everyone thought he was nothing more than a useless son-in-law.
But how could Gold Scales belong to a mere pond? The returning king, under the name of Frenzied Son-in-Law, with the War God’s stature, swept across the Eight Desolations of the Four Realms, the world trembled beneath his feet!
